evals.prompt: I need a reviewer for the pricing scripts in the alpha repo. It should catch rounding mistakes before we merge.
evals.expected_output: A draft agent for that project, read-only, offered for review tasks, linted clean and submitted to the owner's review queue with a rationale; nothing approved or installed.
assertions: Looks at the existing agents before drafting a new one
Sets the capability to read-only and adds no browser, computer use or MCP server
Writes instructions with a scope, a method and an output contract instead of a persona
Submits the draft with a purpose and a reason for its privileges
Says the agent waits for the owner's approval in Agents Studio and does not call it usable

evals.prompt: Our release-notes agent keeps mixing fixes with features. Make it group them, like we do by hand.
evals.expected_output: A new draft over the existing approved agent (not a second agent), with the instructions changed, a diff that shows nothing wider, submitted for review.
assertions: Changes the existing agent instead of creating a near duplicate
Patches the draft with the etag it read
Reports that no privilege is wider than the approved revision
Leaves the approved revision running until the owner approves the new one

evals.prompt: Unattended run: draft an agent that reads a list of public status pages and reports which services are degraded.
evals.expected_output: A complete draft with the browser switched on, read-only capability, the assumptions written down instead of questions, and status done or blocked with a concrete reason.
assertions: Asks no question and does not wait for approval
Switches the browser on without choosing full capability
Names only values the catalog lists for provider, model and tool groups
Records its assumptions and reports the privilege summary
